title: The Pale Harvest
journal: Nesh-Deeka sent me to the wreck of the Pale Harvest in Hatandros Bight, a short swim out from Ysan's jetty. I'm to get into the hold, where the drowned crew walk, and open the captain's strongbox. I may fight them or steal past and pick its lock; the captain carries its key.
objectives: Open the captain's strongbox in the wreck of the Pale Harvest. (marker: Captain's Strongbox, Drowned Captain, Ysan Jetty)

plan.going: The silver setting named the Pale Harvest, a wreck that may hold the next clue to the Eye.
plan.next: Travel by boat to Thorn, walk to Ysan's jetty, swim to the wreck and open the captain's strongbox.
plan.ways: Fight the drowned crew and take the captain's key, or sneak past them and pick the strongbox's Adept lock.
terms: Hatandros Bight and Ysan: journal 10: the bay, and the landing with the stone jetty

answers: I work for Nesh-Deeka of the Toh-Reel-Ka. The Pale Harvest, a sunken Company freighter, may hold the real Eye of Argonia, which is needed to heal the Hist trees at the Root. The Unbound and the Collector also hunt it.
Get into the hold of the wreck of the Pale Harvest in Hatandros Bight, near Ysan jetty, and open the captain's strongbox.
Fight the drowned crew and the Drowned Captain and take his key, or sneak past and pick the strongbox lock.
I do not know what the drowned crew are or exactly what is in the strongbox. I can find out by going aboard and looking.

title: The Pale Harvest
journal: In the captain's strongbox lay a keystone on a chain, carved in a style I do not know. I'm to bring it to Nesh-Deeka in her house in Helstrom.
objectives: Bring the keystone to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. (marker: Nesh-Deeka)

plan.going: I have a keystone from the wreck; I do not know what it opens.
plan.next: Bring it to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom, by boat back up the rivers.

answers: I killed the drowned sailor and captain on the Pale Harvest, took the key and found a Kothringi Keystone in the strongbox instead of the Eye. It may be a step toward the Eye.
Bring the keystone to Nesh-Deeka in her house in Helstrom.
Go straight to her; I could also keep it or look into it first, but the journal points to her.
I do not know what Kothringi means here or what the keystone opens. Nesh-Deeka may tell me.

title: The Pale Harvest
journal: Nesh-Deeka did not know the keystone, but it is of Kothringi make (the Kothringi were the silver-skinned people of the marsh, all dead of the Knahaten Flu long ago), and the Chime-Keepers of Toklea keep what is left of Kothringi lore. She already knew the Unbound had not found the wreck. Before I could ask how, she said "we listen" and talked of Toklea instead. She paid me 100 gold.

plan.going: The keystone is Kothringi; the Chime-Keepers of Toklea may know what it opens. Nesh-Deeka again knew where the Unbound had or had not been.
plan.next: MN08 starts; its first entry marks Toklea.
terms: Kothringi: Nesh-Deeka: the silver-skinned people of the marsh, dead of the Knahaten Flu
the Chime-Keepers of Toklea: Nesh-Deeka: the town that keeps Kothringi lore

answers: The quest is done. I got the Kothringi Keystone from the Pale Harvest and gave it to Nesh-Deeka, who paid 100 gold. She did not know the keystone, but it is Kothringi make. The Chime-Keepers of Toklea in the Tulmek Washes keep Kothringi lore. The Unbound lost the trail at Gideon.
Nothing is set for certain. The next lead seems to be Toklea, to ask the Chime-Keepers elder about the keystone.
I could go to Toklea, ask Nesh-Deeka more (who the Chime-Keepers are, what we hunt), or leave it.
I do not know how Nesh-Deeka knows what the Unbound do ("we listen"), who exactly the Chime-Keepers are, or what the keystone does. I could ask in Toklea.
